I see you walking the streets every night.

A hallucination of denial, but I'm alright.

My vacant eyes stare into the darkening blue.

I continue to ask everything how to find you.

The wind flows through the leaves, whisper a lullaby. (Thought I saw heaven in your amber eyes.)

I've been searching for forever, now forever's through. The mistake to follow the trail of light that seemed to follow you.

I hope you come back to me.

I hope your not coming undone.

I hope for your happiness once again.

(...but all hope is gone.)

You always kept me from falling apart,

I'll just accept I left who I was inside your heart.

(I'm still waiting there...)

Something I never thought I would lose,

how did I know I was suppose to choose.

Now this flower is wilting, how could I have been so blind?

Starting to come to the conclusion you were my hope this whole time.

So many chances to obtain everything,

with fear and consequence freezing all feeling.

Now everything I wanted is unattainable,

and the frustration I feel is unexplainable.

(Every moment we wait, is a moment too late.)
